notes.title: Update for Hypnospace Outlaw: Saves & Surprises Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/3cf2f7af669734e0de22962445b263aab0dbf8f3.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We're here to drop you a new update for Hypnospace Outlaw - the saves & surprises update! 

[h3]We've also got some Slayers X news coming soon - so be sure to keep an eye out when that drops![/h3]

[h3][b]To celebrate, we've got a Steam Daily Deal going for Hypnospace right now, which means you can grab the game for 75% OFF![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/e773ba21e2fa6964859be403cb09fa883b11781b.gif[/img]

[h3]We've made some changes to Steam Cloud Saves, alongside some cool new stuff in-game too! Here's what you can expect to find:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the game engine to its most recent version
[*] Save location migrated for Steam Autocloud cloud-save support, and GlobalSettings save file is no longer synced
[*] Mod.io API update (they changed their API URL)
[*] The application window's close button is now captured by HypnOS, so when you click the [x] to close, it will prompt you to log off first
[*] Two additional people added to credits, we're sorry this took so long!
[*] New default controller layout for a better experience on Steam Deck

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/2bb8f8f2629f9974acf23c11e5151e48ed3692d0.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Here are the in-game changes, spoiler warning if you want these to be a surprise:
[/h3][list]
[*] [spoiler] Some changes to QueenOfSanderverse poetry, what shouldn't have been there is now GONE [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] A popular, much loved Hypnospace user can now safely be flagged on any/all days, which could change the outcome of certain things... [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Hypii is now way more dynamic at the start of the HAP chapter - he might just pick up on the present! [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] HAP page-captured spin animation in the Explorer no longer gets "stuck" [/spoiler]
[/list]

Thank you all again for keeping the Hypnospace universe in check - it's thanks to you enforcers, that Hypnospace is a safe space free of copyright infringement, harassment, and violations! We'll see you next time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844590/Hypnospace_Outlaw/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931020/Slayers_X_Terminal_Aftermath_Vengance_of_the_Slayer/

















































[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/c15e951b3b311fa6a9b9a4711f1d901ff1361cf3.gif[/img]

notes.title: 🔥🔥 the first update for slayers X is here 🔥🔥
notes.content:
whats up its zane. I just wanted to come on here and tell u that your awesome for playing my game. unlike those crybaby psykos bwl…..anyway I added some cool new features to slayers and I fixed some of the bugs the psyko wusses planted in their. Ive broken it down below…. thats it for now but theres more coming to slayers so stayed tuned….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42218571/aef657d9ef6e7439f5868832213bcff3eb7ad620.gif[/img]

- new feature: Level Select screen u get after beating the game, start a new game to access it
- new feature: see total map secrets, enemy, & playtime on the map screen (M by default)
- new feature: frame rate controls
- improved difficulty balancing on InZane & Im Awesome difficulties
- map 5 quicker hackblood recharge so u can get a hang of using it
- fixed keybind bugs
- fix to culling bugs (disappearing level) on map 7
- added bong back under mevins desk... oops accidentally deleted it
- saving/loading fixes for boss and arena fights. (wont retro actively fix things.... u have to restart a map if you have a broken save)
- many other small fixes

were working on other fixes and graphics for ultra wide mode in the next patch.... and some other things hehehaahahahaa
